name: Visual workflow designer
userOutcome: The user can visually compose, validate, simulate, version, and publish supported workflow graphs.
productionDataSource: Versioned workflow definitions, node schemas, roles, teams, policies, and simulation data.
errorBehavior: Preserve the draft, identify invalid nodes and edges, and prevent publication of a graph that cannot execute deterministically.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not make the visual canvas the only accessible representation.
Do not mutate active workflow versions.
acceptanceTests: Create a parallel and fan-in workflow.
Reject a cycle or missing input.
